verdict.line: You lose if you extend trades past Irelia's Ki Burst window and let her passive stack up; you win the 52.7% of games where you burst her in short trades and out-scale into mid game.

brief.thesis: Solo-kill advantage sits with Irelia because her kit stacks Ionian Fervor attack speed and bonus on-hit damage the longer a fight runs, so the 357-game head-to-head favors Riven at 52.7% only when she refuses extended exchanges and instead punishes the gaps between Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) cooldowns. This is a lane where you play defensively, bank Valor to eat her stun-into-dash combo, and let items close the gap she opens early.

theirWindow.what: The two converging blades stun and Mark you, and a Marked target refreshes her Q (Bladesurge) cooldown on hit — expect an immediate dash-strike-heal follow-up, so use E (Valor) to block the incoming damage or disengage the instant you're caught.

yourWindow.when: her E (Flawless Duet) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With her stun/mark tool down (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown), she has no way to lock you down for the Q reset chain — step in with Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) before she can charge W (Defiant Dance) for a bigger hit.

powerCurve.note: Neither combo online, trade only on minion resets
E-stun into Q reset chain is live
R wall plus passive stacks punish long fights
Eclipse burst matches her all-in power
Death's Dance sustain wins skirmishes outright

start.why: The 52.6% win rate over 405 games on this start reflects the reality that you need the extra sustain and early AD just to survive trades until Irelia's E cooldown gaps open up.

boots.why: At 55.4% over 202 games this is the higher-performing choice — the cooldown reduction shortens the gap between your E (Valor) blocks, which is what you're leaning on to survive her stun-dash combo.

core.why: The shield proc lets you tank one hit of her Q (Bladesurge) or E stun combo and still win the trade; this path hits 78.6% win rate over 42 games.
Damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through her burst window before her passive stacks fully ramp.
Sustained healing on hit extends your trading window in exactly the short exchanges this matchup rewards.

situational.when: the game slows down and you need more R (Blade of the Exile) uptime to threaten Wind Slash resets
she builds tanky enough that your Eclipse burst alone can't finish the trade
you're ahead and want more sustain from landing Q (Broken Wings) procs in extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing offset Irelia's higher raw damage in the levels where solo-kill advantage sits with her, letting you win trades you'd otherwise lose on paper.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 96.5% of games at 52.9% win rate — Ignite matters specifically here because it cuts the heal off her Q (Bladesurge), which is her main sustain tool for looping back into you.

playing.title: Trade only on her E cooldown
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown is the only real window where she can't stun-and-mark you into a Q reset chain — commit your Q-W combo there.

playing.title: Save Valor for her stun
playing.detail: Hold E (Valor) to block the damage from her E (Flawless Duet) or the follow-up Q (Bladesurge) strike rather than burning it as a poke tool.

playing.title: Cut fights short at 5 stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor caps out with bonus on-hit damage at max stacks, so disengage or finish the trade before she reaches five spell-hit stacks.

playing.title: Deny her Q minion resets
playing.detail: Bladesurge refreshes its cooldown on a killed or Marked target, so don't let her freely dash a low minion into range right before she all-ins you.

playing.title: Bank Wind Slash for her exit
playing.detail: During R (Blade of the Exile) you get one Wind Slash use at 200 range with bonus AD and range — save it to finish her as she tries to disengage after a failed trade.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 all-in
playing.detail: Vanguard's Edge has a 125-second cooldown at rank 1, so if she uses it and it whiffs you get a long window to punish before she has it again.

playing.title: Interrupt her charged W
playing.detail: Defiant Dance deals more damage the longer she charges it and reduces her physical damage taken while charging — stun her with W (Ki Burst) before she can release it at full value.

brief.patchCaveat: The build path, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade-pattern and cooldown-window reasoning is my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Always be careful when Irelia’s passive has 5 stacks. Focus on dodging Irelia’s (E) when engaging, and use your [Q] slowly to catch her off guard.
